messages:
alex: Deploy-bot flagged a planned maintenance window for model-serving next Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling deploy across clusters; expect brief 1-3m latency spikes and a small chance of 503s for in-flight requests. Opening thread for customer comms and statuspage text :wave:

jamie: thanks — can you drop a status page blurb + email/SMS template? we'll want a short and a long version. cc @lisa for pinning/version note

alex: Short statuspage update (250 chars):
```
Scheduled maintenance: Model serving rollout on Tue 03:00–04:00 UTC. Rolling deploy; brief latency spikes (1–3m) possible. No action required. We’ll update when complete: https://status.redwood.ai
```

alex: Long statuspage body (for incident timeline/details):
```
What: Routine rollout of model-serving runtime (minor version bump, kernel/IO patches).
When: Tue, 03:00–04:00 UTC.
Impact: Rolling deploy may cause short (1–3 minute) latency increases and transient 5xx errors for a subset of requests. No customer data changes expected.
Mitigation: Automatic fallback to previous model variant; healthchecks will roll back nodes failing the post-deploy probe.
ETA: We’ll post a final update within 15 minutes of completion.
```

lisa: Add a pinned-version line — customers on Dedicated may want to pin. Suggest: `Recommended: pin to model-serving@2026-03-18` and include rollback instructions if they see regressions.

alex: Good call. Added pinned version note to long text. Also adding a brief rollback comms snippet for our status page:
```
If we detect increased errors after rollout, we will initiate an automated rollback to the previous runtime version and update this page with timeline and affected regions. Estimated rollback time: ~10 minutes.
```

jamie: Customer email (subject + short body):
Subject: Planned maintenance — model serving rollout (Tue 03:00–04:00 UTC)
Body: Hi — we’ll be performing a routine rollout of our model-serving runtime on Tue 03:00–04:00 UTC. You may see short latency spikes or transient errors for up to a few minutes. No action required. We’ll notify you when complete and provide a link to the status page: https://status.redwood.ai

jamie: SMS/pager template (one line):
`Planned maintenance: model serving rollout Tue 03:00–04:00 UTC — short latency spikes possible. See https://status.redwood.ai`

henry: ops checklist before publish: 1) confirm canary pass criteria 2) ensure rollback playbook linked 3) notify Dedicated customers with pinned-version flag 4) set monitoring alert thresholds to aggressive for first 30m

alex: Checklist noted. I’ll kick the canary 30m before window, and post the statuspage draft after canary passes. Deploy-bot will post automated updates. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0318-001 — will post updates automatically.

lisa: small wording tweak for legal/compliance: replace 'no customer data changes' with 'no customer data will be modified.' Also include link to support contact for Dedicated customers who need a maintenance exemption.

alex: updated wording and added support contact line. Final plan: publish statuspage at canary start, send email 15m before window to impacted accounts, and push SMS to on-call list 5m before. If canary fails, abort and alert customers with rollback note.

henry: :eyes: looks good. Please add the exact email send time and owner in the calendar invite so CS knows when to expect the ping.

alex: will do. setting calendar reminders and adding owners now. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Event status: Scheduled -> In 30m (canary start).
